# Effects::Mgr: s8 loop counters over the racers, used as indices into Sub9d8's tables.

# Retro Rewind (profile retro-rewind): BattleRoyale's EjectItemsFromItemDamage (0x8180ACB0) keeps a
# u16 last-eject frame per racer in sLastEjectFrame[12] at 0x81879DC4 and writes it for every item
# hit in every mode, before its KO Royale check: past 12 racers it wrote over the module's next
# statics. Racers 12+ use a shadow at 0x82D80000 (never reset: a stale frame skips one eject at most).
